clues: This city spreads across the flat delta of the Chao Phraya River. Its low streets sit near the river mouth, close to the sea.
This city has three seasons: hot, rainy, and cool. Monsoon rains start in May, and September soaks the streets the most.
In 1782, a new king moved his capital across the river to an island. He set a city pillar there to mark the new start.
A grand palace stands by the river in this city. Bright temple roofs, like those of Wat Arun, shine close by.
This city is the capital of Thailand, and its Grand Palace still stands at its heart. The whole country's politics runs through its streets.
